_doc: The Booji-Wooji Man milagro cards (Paul's painted cards). refs/<slug>.jpg = the photo crop (rotated portrait); `text` = the border lettering; `subject` = an override when the photographed subject can't ship as-is (see tools/assets/gen_milagros.py). Content + stories: src/game/content/milagros.ts. `photo` = the master is the flattened photo itself (tools/assets/milagro_photo.py: the model refused these). `altered` = a note baked onto the SERVED card at --pack (and shown in-game): the subject differs from Paul's original.
